claim: Portara is the sole remnant of an unfinished 530 BC temple of Apollo begun by Lygdamis, four marble blocks of ~20 tons each, on Palatia islet linked to town by a paved footpath.
quote: a huge marble gate and the single remaining part of an unfinished temple of Apollo of 530 BC ... connected with the Naxos mainland via a paved footpath

claim: The Portara site is open-air, accessible 24/7, with free entry.
quote: The Portara is accessible 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Entry is free.

claim: Portara is 5 minutes across the causeway plus 5 minutes uphill; extremely crowded at summer sunset; grippy shoes needed because the causeway gets slippery in choppy seas.
quote: It's only a 5-minute walk across the causeway and then another 5 minutes to the top of the hill ... If the ocean is really choppy, waves start crashing near the path, making it a bit slippery.

claim: Recommended order for Chora: old town early morning, Kastro mid-morning, promenade after 18:00, Portara in the last hour before sunset; don't drive into town; Portara is 25-30 min on foot from Agios Georgios; allow at least half a day.
quote: Don't drive into town—streets too narrow, parking nonexistent ... Portara is roughly 25-30 minutes from Agios Georgios Beach on foot.

claim: Kastro founded 1207 by Marco Sanudo, pentagonal, reused ancient acropolis and Portara temple marble; free entry, still inhabited; 5-10 min walk from the waterfront or a free lift to Avaton 1739 cafe; Glezos/Crispi Tower is the only survivor of twelve and the only circular one, and will house the biggest Byzantine Museum in the Cyclades once restored; Kastro + Portara walk ~2.5 hours.
quote: Entrance to the Kastro is free ... The Glezos Tower, also called the Crispi Tower, is the only survivor of the twelve towers that once guarded the perimeter ... via a free elevator to the Avaton 1739 Cafe.

claim: Kastro had three gates; Trani Porta (north) and Paraporti (south) survive, Piso Paraporti does not; inside are the Della Rocca Barozzi tower museum, Tower of Crispi, Catholic Cathedral, Panagia Theoskepasti, Capuchin monastery, Archaeological Museum, Capella Kazatza and the Ursuline school (1739).
quote: Paraporti, its southern gate and main entrance for visitors ... the northern Trani Porta ... The Tower of Crispi: the only one surviving of Kastro's twelve towers

claim: Municipality's own walking order through the Kastro: Trani Porta, Della Rocca Barozzi tower, Tower of Crispi, Catholic Cathedral, Panagia Theoskepasti, Capuchin monastery, Archaeological Museum, Capella Kazatza, Ursuline school.
quote: Upon entering via Trani Porta: Della Rocca Barozzi Tower (right side) ... Tower of Crispi ... Catholic Cathedral ... Ursuline School and Monastery

claim: Archaeological Museum of Naxos is closed for the 'Islet of Museums in the Castle of Chora' renovation; since 15 May 2021 a temporary exhibition runs on the second floor of the Saint Ursula Cultural Center, 09:00-14:00, closed Tuesday, free entrance.
quote: From the 15th of May 2021 and for as long as the project lasts a 'Temporary Exhibition' ... on the second floor of the Cultural Center 'Saint Ursula' at the former Ursulines Monastery. Summer (Apr 1 - Oct 31): 09:00 - 14:00, Tuesday closed. Free entrance

claim: Site Museum of Naxos Mitropolis (Metropolis Square) was created in 1999 as Greece's first on-site museum of its type, nominal admission EUR 5, but the ministry listing states it is closed from 01.08.2025.
quote: The Site Museum of Naxos Mitropolis was created in 1999 and it is the first museum of this particular type in Greece ... The museum will be closed from 01.08.2025.

claim: The Mitropolis / Ancient Town Museum is listed as permanently closed.
quote: Permanently closed.

claim: Della Rocca-Barozzi Venetian Museum in the Kastro opens daily 10:00-15:00 and 19:00-22:00, is shown by a staff member, and hosts musical events in its courtyard from April through October.
quote: Daily, 10:00–15:00 & 19:00–22:00 ... The museum also holds a wide variety of musical events in the courtyard in the evenings, from April through October.

claim: Venetian Museum entrance is around EUR 4 and the guided tour lasts about forty minutes, offered in English and Greek.
quote: The Venetian Museum has a pocket-friendly entrance price of 4 Euros ... A guided tour of forty minutes ... bilingual, serving in both English and Greek.

claim: The Domus Festival of classical, jazz, choral, Byzantine and traditional music is held at the Venetian Museum in the garden or basement; tickets are booked in advance at the museum (22850 22387) and include a glass of local wine or kitron.
quote: the Domus Festival of classical, jazz, choral, Byzantine and traditional music held at the Venetian Museum ... Tickets should be booked in advance at the museum (22850 22387) and include a glass of local wine or kítron.

claim: The Domus Festival at the Venetian Museum runs concerts between April and October, including jazz, classical guitar and piano.
quote: various musical events, including jazz, classical guitar, and piano performances ... between April and October

claim: The Catholic Cathedral stands on the central square of the Kastro, dates to the 13th century and is decorated with Naxian marble.
quote: The Catholic Cathedral lies in the central square of Kastro ... dates back to the 13th century ... decorated with Naxian marble

claim: The Orthodox Cathedral, dedicated to Zoodochos Pigi, was established around 1787 by Bishop Neophytos and stands next to the Grotta site and the Metropolis Museum on the north side of town.
quote: established in 1787 by Bishop Neophytos ... located next to the ancient site of Grotta and the Metropolis Museum

claim: Grotta, on the north side of Naxos harbour below Mitropoleos Square, exposes part of the Mycenaean-era capital (~1300 BC) including agora and settlement, with some constructions now submerged in the sea.
quote: on the northern side of the harbor of Naxos, below Mitropoleos Square ... part of the ancient agora and settlement ... Some ancient constructions are seen submerged into the sea today.

claim: Bourgos is the Greek quarter spreading around and below the castle walls, named from the Italian 'borgo'; the seafront district holds the bus station, banks, luggage storage and car rental offices.
quote: The name derives from the Italian word "borgo" ... The seafront area houses the island's bus station, banks, luggage storage facilities, and car rental offices.

claim: The Bourgos Old Market quarter is a maze of narrow streets with shops and stalls; shops skew pricey and weekday mornings are the quiet window, late afternoon the prettiest light.
quote: a maze of narrow streets filled with unique shops, vibrant market stalls ... stores can be a bit pricey ... Weekday mornings provide fewer crowds

claim: Chora deserves two or three days; visit before 9am or late afternoon; the old town is a rabbit warren of arches and marble streets; Agios Georgios is a five-minute walk south from the port; 520 is a rooftop bar in the old market overlooking the port and Kastro.
quote: Rooftop bar in the old market with a terrace overlooking the port and the Kastro ... Agios Georgios Beach is a five-minute walk south from the port

claim: Agios Georgios is about 1 km from the port and town centre, a flat 15-minute walk along the waterfront road, Blue Flag certified; morning secures the best positions before peak heat and late afternoon gives the best light.
quote: approximately 1 kilometre from the port and the center of Naxos Town — a flat easy walk of around 15 minutes along the waterfront road ... Morning arrivals secure the best positions

claim: Naxos sunset times in August 2026: 20:12 on 14 Aug, 20:04 on 20 Aug, 19:49 on 31 Aug.
quote: Aug 14 8:12 PM | Aug 20 8:04 PM | Aug 31 7:49 PM

claim: Named Chora bars include 520 (1700s building with Aegean view), The Naxos Apothecary (near the port, overlooking Portara), Oinochoros (small-winery Greek bottles), On The Rocks (Chora beachfront) and Prime (party bar).
quote: 520 - Cocktails Coffee Shop: situated in a building dating back to the 1700s, with a breathtaking view of the Aegean Sea ... Prime: one of the most famous and notorious party bars in Naxos

claim: Naxos nightlife is concentrated in Chora along the seafront and old-town streets, and bar-hopping there is walkable.
quote: Most night bars are concentrated in the capital along the seafront and the picturesque streets ... Bar hopping in Chora is easy — everything is within walking distance.

claim: The Archaeological Museum's permanent home is a five-storey 17th-century Venetian mansion by the square leading to the castle; the Venetian Museum sits beside the north gate of the castle in the Della Rocca and Barozzi mansions.
quote: housed in an elegant 17th Century Venetian mansion with five storeys ... Located beside the north gate of the castle

claim: The Kastro's north-western entrance still contains its original wooden gate; the archaeological museum building is a former French college where Nikos Kazantzakis studied.
quote: the entrance on the north-western side still contains its original wooden gate ... housed in a former French college where writer Nikos Kazantzakis studied

claim: The causeway to the Portara is about a 5-minute walk from town, and there is no lighting on the road at night.
quote: Simply follow the causeway that connects the islet to the town (about a 5-minute walk) ... be careful if you decide to walk to Portara during night, because there is no light on the road.
